title: Expedition X
description:
S11 E08 — Thunderbird
Recent sightings of a massive bird and reports of missing livestock send Phil and Heather deep into western Pennsylvania. On the hunt for the legendary Thunderbird, they search for proof of the creature that has haunted legends for generations.

title: Expedition X
description:
S08 E08 — The Dogman Conspiracy
The team investigates reports of what some believe is a government conspiracy: the Dogman; this half-wolf, half-man monster is said to stalk the Michigan wilderness, and some even say this creature was created by the US military.

title: Expedition X
description:
S08 E03 — What Lurks in Loch Ness
Phil and Heather investigate a cryptid, the elusive Loch Ness Monster; joined by actor and monster hunter Rhys Darby, they journey deep into the Scottish wilds to explore compelling new evidence beneath Loch Ness' murky waters.

title: Expedition X
description:
S09 E08 — A 'Squatch Above the Rest
Phil and Heather journey into the Kentucky wilderness, searching for sasquatches rumored to be highly intelligent; they quickly find themselves in a chilling game of cat and mouse as the beasts seem always to stay one step ahead of them.

title: Animals on Drugs
description:
S01 E01 — Meth Gators
In a methamphetamine hotspot, drugs seep into local waterways, creating aggressive alligators; wildlife biologist Forrest Galante investigates the effects of meth on these reptiles and attempts to capture and rehabilitate a meth gator.

title: Animals on Drugs
description:
S01 E02 — Drunk Bears
A late-night encounter with a beer-hunting bear sparks a cross-country investigation; wildlife biologist Forrest Galante tracks break-ins and uncovers a strange new trend, bears invading homes to chug booze and devour marijuana edibles.

title: Animals on Drugs
description:
S01 E03 — Cocaine Hippos
Aggressive hippos raised by the cocaine kingpin Pablo Escobar have escaped his abandoned compound in Colombia, becoming a dangerous and deadly invasive species; wildlife biologist Forrest Galante embarks upon a plan to stop them.

title: River Monsters
description:
S09 E02 — Ice Cold Killer
Traveling from London to Greenland and on to Norway, Wade follows the trail of an unknown sea monster; fishing through ice to extreme depths, he attempts to reel in this monster before the full fury of an Arctic storm hits.

title: River Monsters
description:
S09 E04 — Return of the Killer Catfish
Jeremy Wade investigates a case in Nepal that sounds strangely familiar -- a lone fisherman dragged off his feet and into a mountain river by the original river monster, the goonch catfish.

title: River Monsters
description:
S09 E03 — Coral Reef Killer
On the tropical island of Sulawesi, Indonesia, a tourist snorkeler and several local fishermen have been killed and injured by a mysterious sea creature that impales its victims; Wade travels to the scene to investigate.

title: River Monsters
description:
S09 E05 — Volcanic Island Terror
On a volcanic island in the Pacific, terror grips a fishing community when something in the water leaves a trail of bloody victims in its wake; the only clues they have to the attacker's identity are the large puncture wounds it left behind.

title: River Monsters
description:
S09 E06 — Malaysian Lake Monster
After two men vanish from a remote lake in Malaysia, Jeremy sets out to find the possible culprit; a trail of evidence leads Jeremy into an ancient rainforest, where an old adversary lies in wait.

title: River Monsters
description:
Killers From the Abyss
Wade takes on the biggest investigation of his career -- to unravel what happened to over 1,000 passengers of the RMS Laconia, torpedoed in the mid-Atlantic; he travels the globe, battling giant fish, massive sharks and a deep-sea monster.

title: Hoffman Family Gold
description:
S01 E01 — The Toddfather Returns
The first family of gold is back with its biggest gamble yet; Todd Hoffman, his father Jack, and son Hunter tackle a gold-rich Alaskan mine deep with ragged equipment and a rookie crew.

title: Hoffman Family Gold
description:
S01 E02 — Todd's Hot Mess
Todd must deliver 300 ounces of gold in just seven weeks; to make it happen, his first step is getting Hot Mess, a massive broken-down wash plant, up and running; Todd goes rogue and opens a new cut behind the mine owner's back.

title: America's Backyard Gold
description:
S01 E01 — Rivers of Easy Gold
Dave Turin shows where everyday miners can find the new gold uncovered in California, talking about a number of ways ranging from picking nuggets out of rivers to metal detecting rare gold worth millions.

title: America's Backyard Gold
description:
S01 E05 — Desert Gold Boom
Dave Turin shows viewers where and how to find Mojave gold; from traditional dry washing techniques and an ancient Spanish method using a blanket to a modern prospector using his trusty vacuum, there's big gold for the taking.

title: America's Backyard Gold
description:
S01 E07 — Rocky Mountain Nugget Fever
The former Idaho Territory of Idaho and Montana is still rich with gold; Dave shows where and how everyday miners think outside the box to get it.

title: America's Backyard Gold
description:
S01 E08 — Montana Hard Rock Heaven
Dave Turin shows the small-time miners bringing in "gold hard cash" from Montana's hard rock; When a city slicker asks him to assess an old family mine, he goes on a mission and brings cool 21st-century tech to determine its riches.

title: Homestead Rescue
description:
S12 E09 — Brown Bear-anoia
An Alaska family's homestead grinds to a halt, facing an invasion of brown bears displaced by recent wildfires; the Raneys help them build the first-ever homestead fortress to safeguard their livelihood amidst the apex predators.

title: Homestead Rescue: Intervention
description:
S01 E03 — Wylde Mountain Reckoning
In Montana, the Raneys intervene with a family on winter's doorstep; they must scramble to expand their shelter and food storage before being snowed in for good; a surprising revelation in the middle of the rescue threatens to upend the Raneys' plan.

title: Homestead Rescue: Intervention
description:
S01 E06 — North Carolina DIY or Die
After the tragic loss of his father and wife, a young homesteader attempts to survive alone in the mountains of NC using off-grid skills he learned online; when the Raneys intervene, they find a crumbling shelter and no means of subsistence.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S17 E02 — A Midas Mess
Tony's crew sinks a bulldozer and two trucks in the Midas Cut while his grandson flirts with a rock truck driver; Parker pushes to get his second wash plant running; Buzz struggles to assemble a new plant.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S17 E03 — Diagnosing Rick
Rick receives a life-altering diagnosis; Greenhorns push Tony to his breaking point; Parker fires up a third plant and gets surprising gold results.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S17 E04 — Keno City Conclave
Tony ambushes Rick with a secret offer; with high hopes, Parker's crew fires up a fourth plant in the Quagmire Cut; Buzz bets on White Channel pay.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S17 E05 — Low-Grade Panic
Rick hires an engineer to see if he can mine again this season; Parker's crew struggles to keep four plants running; Tony tries to double his gold.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S17 E06 — Rivers of Gold
Rick prospects new ground on Duncan Creek; Tony tasks Nick to deliver their biggest haul of the year; Buzz finds a feeder to increase production.

title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
description:
S02 E05 — Ain't Worth Dying For
As a record-breaking windstorm hits Wyoming, recovery crews work side by side in hurricane-force winds to right rolled semis and clear the interstate; an icy path around Utah Lake overturns a loaded dump truck.

title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
description:
S06 E05 — Bedrock Bottom
With a family facing ruin, setbacks and soaring debt on their BC mine, it's up to Juan and prospecting experts Jeff and Sophia Bond to save them; using 6,000 pounds of steel, Juan creates his largest-ever hopper build to get a massive gold increase.

title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
description:
S01 E06 — Sink or Swim
Freddy and Juan travel to Nome, Alaska, to help save a family's dream and determine why a floating wash plant is losing gold.

S01 E06 — Sink or Swim
Freddy and Juan travel to Nome, Alaska, to help save a family's dream and determine why a floating wash plant is losing gold.

title: Gold Rush: White Water
description:
S09 E07 — The Beginning of the End
Dustin hits rock bottom as he is forced to abandon The Wall dive site after spending all season digging down a deadly 20 feet; the crew finds a new site they call The Golden Straits, and it's now a race to find a season-saving pile of gold.

title: Auction Kings
description:
S01 E09 — Triumph Chopper; Ruby Necklace
A 92-carat ruby necklace; antique Triumph chopper; a case of Billy Beer.

title: Live to Farm
description:
S04 E06
A glimpse into the lives and livings of America's farm families, who work hard and play even harder.

title: Contraband: Seized at Sea
description:
S01 E01 — Murky Waters
A routine inspection of a cargo ship uncovers a well-hidden, illicit load; weapons smugglers attempt to evade authorities; a luxury boat comes on the radar; agents locate a ship filled with people smugglers trying to make landfall.

title: Contraband: Seized at Sea
description:
S01 E02 — Operation Total Silence
HSI agents coordinate a massive raid to take down a transnational drug trafficking gang; agents interdict an erratically moving vessel, often a sign of evasive smugglers, but it turns out that its passengers have less sinister motives.

title: Contraband: Seized at Sea
description:
S01 E06 — The Heat Is On
Agents conducting a random stop-search inspection of vehicles coming off a car ferry get a hit; officers come across a shipment of 80,000 t-shirts that may all be counterfeit; agents descend into a mangrove forest to rescue stranded migrants.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S06 E12 — Paper, Plastic or Ammo?
After a recent gun show in the U.S., officers are on alert; when a man returning to Mexico claims to have gone grocery shopping far from where he lives, his car is inspected; a man smuggling pills has to choose between jail time or giving up names.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S04 E10 — Don't Get Cocky
Two men are caught attempting to smuggle a rooster for cockfighting; officers find millions of dollars of counterfeit goods; a woman flees after dumping drugs on the bridge; an illicit load is found hidden in the axles of a lowboy trailer.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S06 E03 — A Cosmetic Wrinkle
When officers see an approaching vehicle make a sudden U-turn, they give chase and find a bag with a gun and ammunition.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S04 E11 — Ruffled Feathers
Officers receive a tip-off on a vehicle loaded with cartel cash; a man released from jail finds himself in trouble for smuggling hundreds of prescription pills; a magician comes under scrutiny for traveling with a dove he uses as a prop.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E01 — The Tesla Terrorizer
A woman is caught on camera defecating on a car; a man makes off with a tow truck, wreaking havoc through the streets of New York City.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E02 — The Kilted Keisterer?
Tizzy identifies a brazen shopper who places merchandise under his kilt; an angry golfer tees off on bystanders; a man has an ice cream truck meltdown; a woman claims a public beach as her own private yard.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E03 — The Tip Jar Bandit
Tizzy investigates complaints of a serial tip jar thief; a woman goes on a tirade in a parking lot; the police sort out a cyclist's accusations against a motorist.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E04 — The Mystery Pistol Packer
Tizzy tries to identify a man filmed pulling a gun on skateboarders; a road rager who reportedly used his coffee cup as a weapon is identified by his tattoos; a confrontation over a car charger leaves a woman seeking Tizzy's help.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E05 — The Nightmare Neighbor
Tizzy sparks an internet movement to end a woman's racially charged harassment of her neighbors; a parking lot guard is targeted by a driver; a disgruntled customer wrecks a GameStop.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E06 — The Bumper Sticker Brawl
Tizzy investigates an assault triggered by a bumper sticker; a judge dishes out justice for an attack on a fast food worker, and a couple of road rage incidents have Tizzy fired up.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E01 — The Good, the Bad and the Unlucky
As the Golden Nugget's busiest season begins, tempers flare at check-in; a swiped $1,000 chip sparks a hotel-wide high-tech hunt; surveillance targets a team of card counters; and a VIP host gets creative to keep his client gambling.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E05 — Till Death Do Us Shark
Four unique weddings in one day stretch the Golden Nugget's wedding team to their limit; a crack in the 200,000-gallon shark tank raises the alarm; stolen casino keys cause chaos; security breaks up a rowdy wedding party of seniors.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E04 — Nightmare on Fremont Street
A rookie security manager on his first graveyard shift struggles to keep up with an escalating barrage of bizarre calls, ringing one after another; meanwhile, a late-night VIP pickup turns into a cross-town odyssey full of unexpected detours.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E03 — Sex, Lies and Surveillance Tape
A hotel guest reports a theft that launches an investigation with security and Metro detectives, but the truth proves to be far more scandalous.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E02 — Big Bang Theories
Reports of loud bangs and bullet holes on the eighth floor spark a tense night before the cause of the chaos is discovered one floor above.

title: Gold Rush: Parker's Trail
description:
S06 E04 — Bolivia or Bust
Parker follows the gold into Bolivia, where he hopes to tap into its $2.5 billion gold industry; the crew gets a lead on a placer operation but is confronted by the claim's 32 owners at the gate.

title: Gold Rush: Parker's Trail
description:
S06 E05 — Gold Monsters
Parker uncovers a fleet of monster 110-ton excavators scooping pay dirt from the riverbed deep in the Bolivian jungle; just when he gets to the gold, two of his team members fall sick.

title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
description:
S02 E05 — Ain't Worth Dying For
As a record-breaking windstorm hits Wyoming, recovery crews work side by side in hurricane-force winds to right rolled semis and clear the interstate; an icy path around Utah Lake overturns a loaded dump truck.

title: Jeff Dunham's the Cars That Drove Us
description:
S01 E03 — Trans Am
The Pontiac Trans Am isn't just part of the muscle car movement, it's a statement and a complete package on the track or on the streets; a star of "Smokey and the Bandit" and "Knight Rider," the Trans Am pushes muscle cars to the limit.

title: The RVers
description:
Best of RV Touring
Bucket list items: checked off! We show you the kind of wonder and amazement that's just a single decision away.

title: Guided: The Reel Story of Louisiana Guides
description:
S01 E02
Captures the skill, determination and passion it takes to succeed in one of Louisiana's most demanding outdoor professions; from predawn starts and the relentless search for fish to battling Mother Nature, these guides face pressure every day.

title: Tomorrow's World Today
description:
S10 E05 — Tomorrow's Innovators Can't Wait
George sends Greg to the World of Innovation to explore a new wave of curriculum that is transforming classrooms across America, and to experience the national invention contest finals at Inventionland.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S17 E06 — Rivers of Gold
Rick prospects new ground on Duncan Creek; Tony tasks Nick to deliver their biggest haul of the year; Buzz finds a feeder to increase production.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S09 E10 — Pick Your Poison
Swarming wasps, deadly anacondas, poisonous toads, and venomous stingrays surround the survivalists in sun-scorched Brazil; just days into their challenge, a standoff with a poisonous fer-de-lance snake threatens to send both survivalists home.

title: Naked and Afraid: Uncensored
description:
Swamp Don't Care
All-Stars Melissa Miller and Jake Nodar return and must avoid alligators and poisonous snakes in a treacherous Florida swamp; a disoriented survivalist leads to an all-out search by local authorities; with insider facts and extra scenes.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S12 E10 — Bite Me
Surrounded by crocodiles, leopards and venomous snakes, survivalists band together against the South African bush, but scorpion and aggressive tick bites put their challenge at risk.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S13 E02 — Two is a Crowd
Lynsey, a survivalist who thrives in partnerships, finds herself at odds with her companion Darvil, whose lone-wolf tendencies become destructive in the grueling landscape of Lapalala, South Africa.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S13 E06 — Buffalo Bait
In South Africa, two fans attempt a 14-day challenge in the middle of dangerous cape buffalo territory.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S12 E01 — No Rain, No Gain
Torrential downpours hammer the survivalists as soon as they're dropped into the Georgia rainforest; pushed by the weather, mountain lions, black bears and poisonous copperheads; the pair create a bond that leads to a life-changing decision.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S17 E07 — Put Up or Shut Up
Two "Naked and Afraid" superfan critics use their armchair survival knowledge to try to endure 14 days in the jungles of Colombia.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S02 E02 — Double Hurricane Disaster
In 2024, hundreds of cameras capture hurricanes slamming Florida's Gulf Coast; as category four Hurricane Helene brings record flooding, residents have no chance to recover before category three Hurricane Milton unleashes over 40 tornadoes.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E11 — Father's Day Fury
A rogue storm in the Texas Panhandle ignites a monster outbreak, unleashing over 80 tornadoes across 14 states; witnesses scramble for safety as a deadly EF3 cuts power and silences tornado sirens.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E05 — The Dakota EF5
Eyewitnesses capture severe weather across the Dakotas as tornadoes tear through neighborhoods and farm structures.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E12 — The 40-State Storm
In January 2026, a 2000-mile winter storm unleashes chaos across 40 states; a 100-car pileup traps motorists in Michigan, a freight train smashes a stranded semi and first responders race to save a driver sinking in a frozen pond.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E07 — Stranded in St. Louis
In May 2025, eyewitnesses capture scenes of destruction as a mile-wide tornado tears through the city of St. Louis; when warning sirens fail, residents are caught off guard while visitors panic 630 feet above the ground inside the Gateway Arch.
